name: Beekeeper Studio
summary: Beekeeper's current docs say telemetry is opt-in and excludes query content, database data and connection details, and its retention page says diagnostic and usage data is kept up to 12 months. A 2024 maintainer reply said there was no telemetry at all, so the current status should be confirmed in the app.

optOut.instructions: Telemetry is off unless you opt in, so decline any anonymous usage data consent prompt. The exact in-app setting and its location were not confirmed.
